pages.description: A sleeping cat curls inside a wicker basket in this printable coloring page, resting its face on tucked paws above a blanket with a fringed edge. pages.title: Cat Stretching Its Front Legs Forward After Waking Up Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a cat stretching its front legs across a bed after waking, with closed eyes, raised hindquarters, and an upward-curving tail. pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a cat scratching a tall sisal post beside a toy mouse, standing on its hind legs with both front paws raised. pages.title: Tabby Cat Walking Beside a Garden Fence with Stripes Across Its Body and Rings Around Its Tail Coloring Page
pages.description: A striped tabby walks beside a garden fence in this printable coloring page, extending one front paw and holding its ringed tail high above its back. pages.title: Cat Perched on a Windowsill Watching Birds in the Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a cat perched on a windowsill watching two garden birds, one flying and one resting on a leafy branch outside. pages.title: Cat Peering Into a Round Fishbowl at a Swimming Goldfish Coloring Page

pages.title: Cat Crawling Through a Play Tunnel Toward a Toy Ball Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a cat crawling from a play tunnel toward a striped toy ball, stretching its front paws beyond the circular opening. Curved bands divide the tunnel on this coloring sheet, while pointed ears, whiskers, and a raised tail add details around the cat's broad face.

pages.title: Cat Reaching From a Cat-tree Platform Toward a Hanging Toy Coloring Page
pages.description: A cat reaches from a cat-tree platform toward a hanging ball in this printable coloring page, raising one front paw and looking up at the toy. The coloring sheet shows two platforms above a base, rope-wrapped supports, and a long curved tail, combining broad surfaces with repeated narrow bands.

pages.title: Cat Walking Along a Tiled Rooftop Beside a Brick Chimney Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a cat walking along a tiled rooftop beside a brick chimney, with one front paw extended and its tail curling upward. The coloring sheet leaves plenty of open sky above, while rows of curved roof tiles and outlined bricks create larger repeating shapes below.

pages.title: Cat Following a Butterfly Through a Patch of Daisies Coloring Page
pages.description: A cat follows a butterfly through a patch of daisies in this printable coloring page, looking upward while lifting one front paw above the grass. Spotted butterfly wings and rounded flower petals provide enclosed details on this coloring sheet, surrounding the cat's fluffy chest and long, raised tail.

pages.title: Cat Meeting a Mouse Beside a Wedge of Cheese Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a seated cat meeting a small mouse beside a wedge of cheese, with the animals facing each other across the floor. Round cheese holes, the mouse's large ears, and the cat's pointed whiskers distinguish this coloring sheet, which keeps the surrounding background mostly open.

pages.title: Cat and Dog Resting Together on the Same Pet Blanket Coloring Page
pages.description: A cat and dog rest together on the same pet blanket in this printable coloring page, lying side by side with their front paws stretched forward. The coloring sheet contrasts the cat's pointed ears with the dog's floppy ears, and adds fluffy chest outlines, curled tails, and blanket folds.

pages.title: Mother Cat Nursing Three Kittens in a Nesting Bed Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a mother cat nursing three kittens in a rounded nesting bed, with her body curved around the small kittens' backs. The coloring sheet includes tucked paws, curling tails, and a thick cushioned rim, leaving broad fur areas between the finer whisker and bedding lines.

pages.title: Kitten Batting a Loose Strand From a Ball of Yarn Coloring Page
pages.description: A kitten bats a loose strand from a ball of yarn in this printable coloring page, holding its paw above the ball with a smile. Overlapping yarn bands create narrow sections on the coloring sheet, while the kitten's pointed ears, long whiskers, and fluffy chest leave larger open areas.

pages.title: Kitten Climbing Out of a Cardboard Box with a Folded Flap Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a kitten climbing out of a cardboard box, resting both front paws on a folded flap with its tail raised behind. The coloring sheet combines the box's large rectangular panels with the kitten's fluffy silhouette, wide eyes, triangular ears, and small open mouth.

pages.title: Kitten Sitting Inside a Large Teacup with Its Front Paws Resting on the Rim Coloring Page
pages.description: A kitten sits inside a large teacup in this printable coloring page, placing its front paws on the rim above a pattern of stars and circles. The coloring sheet includes a matching saucer, a curved handle, and floating hearts, with broad cup sections and small decorative shapes around the kitten.

pages.title: Kitten Investigating an Overturned Flowerpot Beside Blooming Sunflowers Coloring Page

pages.title: Two Kittens Gently Wrestling on a Round Rug Coloring Page
pages.description: Two kittens gently wrestle on a round rug in this printable coloring page, with one lying on its back and the other leaning over its paws. The coloring sheet focuses on their open mouths, pointed ears, and fluffy tails, with a simple double border around the oval-shaped rug.

pages.title: Kitten Touching Its Reflection in a Floor Mirror with One Front Paw Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a kitten touching its reflection in a floor mirror, raising one front paw until it meets the matching reflected paw. The tall rectangular frame and mirror streaks give this coloring sheet straight sections beside the kitten's curved back, curled tail, and fine whiskers.

pages.title: Kitten Hiding Beneath a Sofa with Its Face and Front Paws Visible Coloring Page
pages.description: A kitten hides beneath a sofa in this printable coloring page, showing its round face, pointed ears, and two front paws between the furniture's legs. The coloring sheet keeps the kitten small beneath the broad seat and arms, with a few floorboard lines and large open upholstery panels.

pages.title: Kitten Pouncing on a Feather Toy Lying on the Floor Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a kitten pouncing on a feather toy lying on the floor, stretching both front paws forward with its hindquarters raised. Two outlined feathers and a round toy center sit below the kitten on this coloring sheet, which features fluffy cheeks and an upward-curving tail.

pages.title: Kitten Reaching for Falling Autumn Leaves Beneath a Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: A kitten reaches for falling autumn leaves beneath a tree in this printable coloring page, stretching one paw upward and looking toward a large drifting leaf. The coloring sheet combines open fur sections with pointed leaf shapes, visible paw pads, a curved trunk, and scattered leaves along the ground.

pages.title: Kitten Wearing a Party Hat Beside a Birthday Cake and Balloons Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a kitten wearing a party hat beside a birthday cake and balloons, with striped fur and a wide, open smile. Three lit candles, dotted icing, and the hat's round spots add enclosed details to the coloring sheet, balanced by large balloons and broad cake sections.

pages.title: Maine Coon Cat Sitting on a Tree Stump with Its Bushy Tail Draped Over the Edge Coloring Page
pages.description: A Maine Coon sits on a tree stump in this printable coloring page, with tufted ears, a thick chest ruff, and its bushy tail draped downward. The coloring sheet uses many pointed fur sections around the face and body, with simpler bark lines and small grass tufts beneath the stump.

pages.title: Persian Cat Reclining on a Tasseled Cushion with Its Long Coat Spread Around Its Paws Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Persian cat reclining on a tasseled cushion, with its long coat spreading around its front paws and rounded face. Flowing fur sections fill much of the coloring sheet, while the cushion adds curved seams, a twisted border, and hanging tassels at both sides.

pages.title: Siamese Cat Standing on a Low Garden Wall with Its Long Tail Raised Coloring Page
pages.description: A Siamese cat stands on a low garden wall in this printable coloring page, holding its long tail upright above an outlined face mask and lower-leg markings. The coloring sheet includes large stone blocks, simple flowers, and shrubs, leaving broad spaces across the cat's back, chest, and surrounding garden.

pages.title: Bengal Cat Stepping Across Smooth Stones Beside a Shallow Pond Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Bengal cat stepping across smooth stones beside a shallow pond, extending one front paw above the water toward the foreground. The coloring sheet features outlined coat spots, a ringed tail, ripples, reeds, lily pads, and a water flower, combining detailed markings with broad rocks.

pages.title: Ragdoll Cat Resting Across a Sofa Arm with Its Front Paws Hanging Over the Side Coloring Page
pages.description: A Ragdoll cat rests across a sofa arm in this printable coloring page, with both front paws hanging over the side and its long tail draped down. The coloring sheet contrasts pointed fur tufts and facial markings with the sofa's large plain panels, curved arm, seat cushion, and tapered leg.

pages.title: Sphynx Cat Sitting Beside a Warm Radiator with the Folds of Its Skin Visible Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Sphynx cat sitting beside a radiator, with large upright ears and skin folds across its forehead, neck, and body. pages.title: British Shorthair Cat Looking Out From a Round Opening in a Cat House Coloring Page
pages.description: A British Shorthair looks out from a round cat-house opening in this printable coloring page, resting its front paws on the rim beneath a hanging ball. The coloring sheet emphasizes rounded cheeks and wide eyes, with a circular shelter, two rope-wrapped supports, and a broad base forming larger sections.

pages.title: Scottish Fold Cat Sniffing a Daisy with Its Folded Ears Visible Coloring Page

pages.title: Calico Cat Standing Among Garden Flowers with Large Patches Across Its Coat Coloring Page

pages.title: Tuxedo Cat Sitting on a Doorstep with Its Chest Bib and Sock Markings Visible Coloring Page

pages.description: A cat looks around a garden in this printable coloring page, sitting on a stepping-stone path between rounded bushes and tall flowers beside a picket gate. The coloring sheet emphasizes the cat's large eyes and whiskers, with broad body sections surrounded by petal shapes, leaves, and individual path stones.

pages.title: Cat Drinking Water Near A Wooden Fence Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a cat drinking water near a wooden fence, bending toward a shallow bowl with its tongue touching the rippled surface. The coloring sheet includes the cat's curved back, raised tail, and rounded paws, with wood-grain lines, fence rails, and grass tufts around the bowl.

pages.title: Cat Napping Calmly Near A Stream Coloring Page
pages.description: A cat naps calmly near a stream in this printable coloring page, resting its head on its front paws with its long tail curled around its body. Rounded clouds and a tree sit behind the cat on this coloring sheet, with stones and flowing water lines along the stream below.

pages.title: Cat Playing Gently In A Nature Reserve Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a cat playing gently in a nature reserve, resting one paw on a segmented ball beside a winding path and rounded bushes. The coloring sheet adds tall simple trees, three flying birds, and a large rayed sun, leaving broad spaces across the cat and sky.

pages.title: Cat Playing With A Butterfly In A Backyard Coloring Page
pages.description: A cat plays with a butterfly in a backyard in this printable coloring page, standing on its hind legs and lifting a paw toward patterned wings. The coloring sheet includes visible paw pads, a pointed picket fence, a large flower, and grass tufts, with clear open areas around the two subjects.

pages.title: Cat Playing Happily In A Cartoon Village Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a happy cat playing in a cartoon village, lifting its paws beside a ball of yarn above a winding cobblestone path. Mushroom houses, flying birds, and an apple tree fill the coloring sheet, with round windows and small roof spots surrounding the cat's broad body.

pages.title: Cat Standing Happily In A Coral Reef Coloring Page
pages.description: A happy cat stands in a coral reef in this printable coloring page, wearing a snorkel mask among striped fish, a turtle, and rising bubbles. The coloring sheet includes tube-shaped coral, branching coral, rounded stones, and the cat's upright tail, with small reef sections around its larger open body.

pages.title: Cat Sitting Calmly In A Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a cat sitting calmly in a forest, facing forward between tall trunks with broad face markings and its tail curled beside its paws. The coloring sheet includes large leaves, mushrooms, scattered stones, and outlined bark patterns, mixing open body areas with narrower woodland details.

pages.title: Cat Looking Happy On Sea Ice Coloring Page
pages.description: A happy cat sits on sea ice in this printable coloring page, with a striped tail curving upward above an outlined ice floe surrounded by water. The coloring sheet adds distant angular icebergs, broad clouds, and a rayed sun, contrasting the cat's rounded body with cracked ice sections below.

pages.title: Cat Sitting Calmly On A Farm Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a cat sitting calmly on a farm, closing its eyes beside two flowers with a barn and silo in the background. The coloring sheet includes crossed barn doors, fence rails, rounded clouds, and a curled tail, with large open areas across the cat and farm buildings.

pages.title: Cat Playing Happily In A Nature Reserve Coloring Page
pages.description: A happy cat plays in a nature reserve in this printable coloring page, leaping toward a butterfly with one paw raised above a flower-dotted riverbank. The coloring sheet includes a winding stream, rounded trees, rocks, and distant hills, surrounding the cat's broad body with simple landscape and petal shapes.

pages.title: Cat Hugging Happily In A Vegetable Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a happy cat hugging beside smiling vegetables in a garden, with one paw raised and another reaching around a tall ear of corn. A pumpkin and cabbage fill the foreground of the coloring sheet, with garden leaves, a wooden fence, and a pointed sun behind them.

pages.title: Cat Listening Carefully In The Countryside Coloring Page
pages.description: A cat listens carefully in the countryside in this printable coloring page, sitting upright with tall pointed ears and its eyes turned toward one side. The coloring sheet includes a rail fence, rolling fields, rounded trees, distant birds, and small grass tufts, keeping broad open areas around the cat's face and chest.

pages.title: Cat Eating Happily On A Mountain Trail Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a happy cat eating on a mountain trail, holding a large fish near its mouth while sitting beneath floating hearts and sparkles. The coloring sheet includes visible paw pads, fish scales, a winding stone path, snowcapped peaks, and distant trees around the cat's rounded body.
